history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration review the procurement issues that arose from previous solicitations to ensure that lessons learned are incorporated into the new procurement process for the same requirements to ensure that the process is in accordance with the following United Nations procurement principles.
history.administration_response: The Office of Information and Communications Technology requests that the recommendation be closed. The solicitation process for replacement contracts was completed in December 2023, and new contracts have been awarded to three vendors. The factual basis of this recommendation is therefore obsolete. Procurement Division: Following a previous solicitation for ICT professional services, which was unsuccessful owing primarily to the challenge of finding vendors capable of delivering all services across all United Nations locations, the Procurement Division and the requisitioner developed a new strategy, informed by the most recent category management review and stakeholder consultations. The key improvements included restructuring requirements into multiple technical categories and lots, introducing a more flexible workforce competency framework and dividing the global scope into four regions.
history.board_assessment: Given that multiple vendors are engaged in providing contractual services to the United Nations, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
